name: Tempting Honeyfruit
descriptionTemplate: Caraboo gains [Arg2]% Base Aliemus. {Rouse}: After using {Crimson Furnace}, the next {Miracle Blessing} costs -3 Arithmetica, and each {Discover} option is upgraded to a set that contains 1 more {derived:Caraboo's Blessing} card. Choose 1 set to shuffle into your Draw Pile.
lore:
Greed is the true color of human nature.
No one can resist the temptation of sugar, not even the Fairy Godmother herself.
Caraboo grinned wide, baring a mouthful of pitch-black, pointed teeth.
